preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles K must be between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i < 1000 and 1 <= y_i < 1000 and 1 <= z_i < 1000 for (x_i, y_i, z_i) in needles)
preconditions.description: Each coordinate of the triples must be between 1 and 999.
The number of provided needles must match the specified count K.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'True closed chains' if has_true_closed_chain else 'No true closed chains'
postconditions.description: The first line of output indicates the presence of true closed chains.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Floor closed chains' if has_floor_closed_chain else 'No floor closed chains'
postconditions.description: The second line of output indicates the presence of floor closed chains.
